title: StatusRecord - one change of a container's status (core v2 section 11)
description: A status change is a record AND its anchor; without a read anchor the status has no time (core v2 section 11, audit Ya-2). Records form a chain: record 0 is the printing and links to the section root, the hash of the emission and the serial; every next record links to the hash of the one before it. A status that does not change writes nothing.

number.description: The counter. Record 0 is the printing; every change adds one.

status.description: The status after the change, by its normative number (KS-7). 11 and 13-19 are not statuses; 8 and 33 are reserved blanks with no transitions.

event.description: The event that caused the change. Omitted, not null, on record 0, which no event caused.

prev.description: The previous record's hash; for record 0, the section root.
